title: Meta- and Google-backed Indian telecom operator Jio Platforms gets regulatory nod for IPO
summary_full: India's largest digital and telecom operator, Jio Platforms, got a regulatory nod for an IPO, but the National Stock Exchange, another mega issue, is still awaiting regulatory clearance.
